description:
Step 5 -- homogeneous map(k,v) with parametric key/value types. DEFERRED behind the ground-literal-value fold (fz-yj0): building a homogeneous-map axis on today's fragmented MapKey is premature -- MapKey is one of four duplicative literal-value carriers (fz-yj0 folds them into a single GroundValue leaf type). map(k,v) has no precise Ty to target today (MapSig models only exact literal-keyed records + map_top; sigs.rs "arbitrary-keyed maps fall back to map_top").

Once a real literal key (GroundValue) exists, RE-EVALUATE map typing and keying TOGETHER:
- (a) should map field keys be GroundValue (any ground value, matching runtime maps) rather than atom/int-only?
- (b) does homogeneous map(k,v) still need a Ty axis (e.g. MapSig.rest: Option<(Ty,Ty)> -- "every non-field key is K-typed -> V") once richer literal keys reframe the key-domain question?

Supersedes the earlier DEEP-homogeneous-axis design pass (MapSig.rest with subtype/emptiness/join/meet rules): correct in the abstract, but sequenced AFTER the fold so the key model is settled first. Reconsider it -- and whether it is even still needed -- after fz-yj0 lands.

Blocked by fz-yj0, fz-usm.3, fz-usm.4. Do NOT start until the fold lands and the map re-evaluation is authorized (per no-silent-deferrals).

comments.text: DECISION (user, 2026-07-06): DEEP -- add a real homogeneous-map Ty axis (not the lossy map_top approximation). User wants to DISCUSS the design before implementation. Producing a grounded design proposal (current MapSig/Descr/map_top model + the homogeneous axis's lattice rules: subtype/emptiness/join/meet + integration with exact-map and top + blast radius + sub-DAG) for review BEFORE any coding. Do NOT start implementation until the design is agreed.

title: fz-usm DECISION: homogeneous map(k,v) -- DEFERRED behind the GroundValue fold; re-evaluate map keying with a real literal key
